theme: Wheels up for Toronto and ICGN.
greeting: The morning is yours in St. Pete, Dan, before an afternoon flight north. Governance week starts tonight in Toronto.

needsAttention.title: Arrive at ICGN with a short list in hand
needsAttention.detail: You land in Toronto tonight for the ICGN Board Dinner tomorrow at Lee Restaurant, the evening before the conference. Worth deciding on the flight who you most want to connect with on board governance and AI oversight before you're in the room.
